summary: Byte strings in Python 3.5+ have no format() method but do support percent formatting.
questions: How do I format a byte string in Python 3?

answer_card.title: Formatting byte strings
answer_card.answer_md:
Bytes have no `.format()` in Python 3.5+; use `%`:
```python
b_command_line = b'ansible-playbook --become-user %s -K %s' % (user, playbook_file)
```
